git_state.head_commit_message: feat: DermAI UI/UX V2 complete research workstation

environment.hardware: Apple MacBook M4 (16 GB unified memory)

deployed_model_identity.preprocessing: Resize(256, 256, BILINEAR) -> CenterCrop(224) -> ToTensor() -> Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])

baseline_tests_and_builds.nextjs_production_build: Compiled successfully (8/8 static pages, First Load JS shared 87.3 kB)

baseline_known_defects.summary: OOD gate uses 7 demo images as MobileNetV2 prototypes; rejects 100% (50/50) of unseen in-domain HAM10000 test images at threshold 0.55 and 92% (46/50) at threshold 0.50, while falsely accepting synthetic text documents (score 0.5817).
models/fusion.py only implements V2 scalar gating (9,031,241 params), failing strict=True loading on V1 matrix-gated checkpoints (dual_branch_seed123 and dual_branch_seed999, 10,669,639 params).

predict_and_explain runs preprocessing twice and EfficientNet-B4 forward pass twice, plus a separate MobileNetV2 forward pass; retains computation graph (retain_graph=True) and activation/gradient tensors between requests; permanent backward hook adds overhead to all predict() calls.
api/inference_engine.py loads checkpoint with strict=False, exposes local absolute filesystem paths in API responses, and lacks startup MPS warmup causing 3.77s/6.40s cold-start spikes.
Frontend and backend /benchmark hardcode historical summary figures without per-class precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices, or Dual-Branch V1 vs V2 versioning metadata.
